goal: Allow a brand-specific hero without forcing the agent to invent the entire structure from scratch.

costModel.defaultPath: Use this manifest to choose mode, layout, and content shape before writing any hero props.
costModel.latencyRule: If no real visual or proof exists, use single-column instead of iterating toward a split hero.
avoid: multiple speculative hero rewrites before picking a mode
large decorative placeholder panels above the fold
trying several hero structures by rebuilding after each one

splitAllowedWhen: there is a marked placeholder image block
there is a proof card or structured proof list with a clear job
collapseToSingleColumnWhen: the right side would otherwise be decorative only
the support content is too weak to justify a second column
the brand is carried mainly by typography and copy

colorGuardrails.rule: Use one dominant background family, one accent, and one support tone.
avoid: muddy purple-pink gradients unless explicitly justified
color intensity that is louder than the offer
nightclub-poster energy for trust-sensitive or booking-sensitive offers
prefer: brand-fit color discipline over maximal palette usage

editorial-cream.shape: warm light base + dark text + restrained warm accent
notes: Use cream, parchment, blush-beige, oxblood, espresso, muted rose
Best when typography does the heavy lifting

midnight-luxe.shape: dark neutral base + one rich accent + one softened highlight
notes: Use black-plum, deep brown, aubergine, oxblood, muted coral, warm ivory
Do not use full purple-pink washes without strong justification

trust-light.shape: light neutral base + calm text + disciplined accent
notes: Use ivory, stone, slate, ink, muted red, muted blue, copper
If trust matters, this should beat louder palette families by default

kinetic-dark.shape: dark base + crisp contrast + tightly limited bright accent
notes: Use charcoal, deep navy, electric but controlled accent, and one cool support tone
Only use when the offer can support high energy visually
Avoid muddy blends and more than one dominant bright accent

rewriteTriggers: generic startup hero with swapped nouns
subhead or bullets repeat the headline
second column has no clear job
giant placeholder media block with no payoff
loud gradient treatment overpowering the copy
support content removable without changing the impression
